title: PostgreSQL Connection
description: Allow users to connect to a PostgreSQL database, import existing schemas as diagrams, and export diagrams as database schemas with DDL preview and confirmation. Credentials are session-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Connect to PostgreSQL via host, port, database, user, and password
Import existing PostgreSQL schema (tables, columns, types, PK, FK, unique constraints, indexes) as a diagram
Export diagram to PostgreSQL with DDL preview and explicit user confirmation
Database credentials are session-only and never persisted
